message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the facts and determine which crimes under Chinese criminal law are directly supported.

Facts: Mine accident due to safety violations, resulting in death of four workers. The mine's actual controlling person (刘XX) and legal representative/miner (刘2某X) were negligent, failed to manage safety, allowed unsafe work, leading to accident. After accident, they concealed and did not report, reached compensation with families, but hid. They were later investigated. They confessed, etc. The prosecution says their behavior violates Criminal Law, constituting "××". We need to fill in the appropriate statutory crimes.

Potential crimes: Under Chinese law, causing death due to negligence in production safety is "重大责任事故罪" (Crime of major production safety accident) under Article 338 of Criminal Law (now Article 338? Actually Article 338 of the Criminal Law of PRC: "在生产、工作中违反安全管理规章制度，造成重大事故，致人重伤、死亡或者使公私财产遭受重大损失的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑”。 This is "重大责任事故罪". Also "隐瞒事故罪" (failure to report a major accident) is "不报告事故罪" under Article 336? Actually Article 336: "不报告事故罪" (failure to report a major accident). The law: "在生产、工作中发生重大事故，负有报告义务的人员不报告，致使事故后果扩大或者造成其他严重后果的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役”。 So they concealed and didn't report. So crimes: "重大责任事故罪" and "不报告事故罪". Also possibly "过失致人死亡罪" (negligent homicide) but in production safety context, the specific crime is "重大责任事故罪". The law also has "玩忽职守罪" (dereliction of duty) for officials, but they are not state officials. For enterprise leaders, the specific is "重大责任事故罪". Also "隐瞒事故罪" is separate.

Thus answer: [罪名]重大责任事故罪;不报告事故罪<eoa>
